messages:
emma_j: Heads-up: new Dedicated capacity offering rolling out - NVIDIA H100S (80GB) instance pools are going live in us-west-2 and eu-central-1 this month. This affects reservations and burst behavior.
raj_s: Nice! Is this going to be opt-in or auto-assigned for existing Dedicated customers?
emma_j: Opt-in for the pilot. Well enable a console toggle for org admins. After pilot well make it GA and available in the reserve flow.
infra-bot: infra:pool-provisioned h100s-usw2a by infra-deploy at 2025-04-01T09:02:13Z
lena_t: Can you share the pilot cadence and how customers request access?
emma_j: Pilot windows:
- us-west-2 pilot starts 2025-04-07 (limited to 3 customers per region)
- eu-central-1 pilot starts 2025-04-21
Customers request via Console > Dedicated > Reserve > Request Early Access, or via SE.
sam_g: What about pricing and perf signals? Any early metrics?
emma_j: Summary: H100S improves long-context generative throughput; internal tests show 30% reduction in p95 latency on decoding-heavy workloads vs A100-40GB for the same batch size. Per-unit price will be higher; unit-cost-per-token often improves due to throughput. Detailed perf docs will be published on the internal docs page.
raj_s: Any changes to allocation or burst policies? Customers are asking if they can spike beyond reservation.
emma_j: Two policy updates for Dedicated:
1) Burst windows: orgs with active reservations can burst up to 2x for short windows (max continuous 20m, cumulative 2h/day). Burst consumes shared spare capacity; not guaranteed.
2) AZ scoping: pools are created per-AZ. For cross-AZ redundancy customers should reserve in multiple AZs.

infra-bot: alert:capacity-low us-west-2b at 2025-04-02T02:15:00Z
lena_t: How do customers reserve via CLI? Example?
emma_j: CLI sample:
```
redwood dedicated reserve --org acme --region us-west-2 --az us-west-2a --gpu H100S-80GB --count 4 --term 1m
```
Note: in pilot zones provisioning can take 1-3 hours.

sam_g: Any console UX changes? banners, migration helpers?
emma_j: Yes  we added:
- Console banner on Dedicated for pilot regions
- Reservation flow includes telemetry consent checkbox (opt-out available)
- Migration assistant: suggests model/quantization pairings and a canary rollout template.

raj_s: Owners for customer comms? We should coordinate Sales/CS messaging about billing impact.
emma_j: Product will own the GA announcement. CS & Sales will get a pre-brief this week. Lena, can you draft the pilot invite and the GA FAQ?
lena_t: Yep Ill draft and loop in sales and legal for billing copy.

infra-bot: runbook:update dedicated-h100s added by oncall at 2025-04-01T12:30:00Z
sam_g: Anything SRE should watch for during pilot? metrics/alerts?
emma_j: SRE checklist: watch p99 latency, queue depth, node OOMs, and placement failures. Well push a prometheus dashboard and a runbook link in the pilot channel.

lena_t: One final thing  can we confirm default quotas?
emma_j: Default GPU quotas unchanged. We added a new "burst slot" quota (opt-out). To raise quotas customers open a support request or reach their AM.

raj_s: Great, thanks. Looking forward to perf numbers.
emma_j: Thanks everyone. Ill post the pilot invite and a template email by EOD.
